mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) compresses discount rates and stimulates equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as monetary policy eases.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 2.5%, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is less than 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A declining unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 3.5% signals a tightening labor market, boosting corporate hiring and profits, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when UNRATE < 3.5%, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is less than 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 290) and weak housing starts (HOUST < 1500) signal an economic slowdown, prompting Fed policy caution and negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 290 and HOUST < 1500, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is less than 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS rising > 0.5pp in 3 months), the S&P 500 experiences negative forward returns as higher rates compress earnings growth and equity valuations.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods classified as monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS rising > 0.5pp in 3 months), or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is less than 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A high industrial production index (INDPRO > 100) indicates robust economic activity, supporting corporate earnings growth and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when INDPRO > 100, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is less than 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Persistent high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 290) signals the Federal Reserve will tighten policy, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days as discount rates rise.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 290, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is less than 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Strong job growth (PAYEMS > 150000) combined with low unemployment (UNRATE < 4.0) signals a tight labor market, boosting corporate profits and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when PAYEMS > 150000 and UNRATE < 4.0, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is less than 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During a late-cycle expansion (GDPC1 growth rate < 2.0% and > 0.5% year-over-year), the S&P 500 experiences negative forward returns as economic momentum wanes and recession risks rise.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods classified as late-cycle expansion (GDPC1 growth rate < 2.0% and > 0.5% year-over-year), or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is less than 0.03.
